sentences.en: Having lived in the town, I'm not a stranger there.
sentences.zh: 在那里住了这么久，我已经不是陌生人了。

sentences.en: A stranger came up to me and asked the way.
sentences.zh: 一个陌生人过来问我路。

sentences.en: Barking at strangers is a habit common to many dogs.
sentences.zh: 对陌生人吠叫是许多狗的常见习惯。

senses.zh: 陌生人，不认识的人,外地人,局外人,门外汉adj.不熟悉的，陌生的(strange)的比较级
